devdoc.details: QuoterV2 is deliberately called in buy to reselect on-chain; this costs gas. A successful sell probe is evidence only for that amount/path in this transaction.

buy(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256).details: minOut and minBuyAmount apply before the optional sell probe. The retained share of that minimum also protects the recipient's final receipt. With a 100% sell probe no output token is sent; recovered input stays in this contract. A fresh owner-signed buy is allowed while disarmed. All old epochs are invalid.

params.config: WETH, V2 factory, V2 router, V3 factory, SwapRouter02, QuoterV2.

quoteBest(uint256).details: Not view: use eth_call/staticCall from the client. Individual failed quotes are skipped.

runTaxSimulation((address,address,addres.details: Only callable by this contract inside simulateTax's reentrancy guard. External callers and token/router callbacks cannot commit a simulation.

simulateTax((address,address,address,uin.details: The outer frame alone produces TaxReport. A malicious token's forged report is wrapped in TaxSimulationFailed and must never be decoded as success.

simulateTaxWithDex((address,address,addr.details: Same revert-only measurement boundary, with a frozen draft DEX policy.

trigger(uint256).details: Epoch is mandatory: pending transactions from an old task cannot execute a new task. Authorization is based on msg.sender, including explicitly allowed smart wallets.

buy(uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: amountIn=0 spends the entire prefunded input-token balance.

depositNative().notice: Wraps only this call's msg.value; pre-existing ETH is not swept.

setSettingsAndDex((address,address,addre.notice: Atomic policy changes invalidate every previously signed trigger.

setSettingsAndFeesAndTax((address,addres.notice: checkBurn is the high-tax guard switch. When enabled it also forces a sell probe; the independent testSell switch can still test sellability alone.

setTriggerWallets(address[],bool).notice: Both grants and revocations invalidate the old armed task. Re-arming must be a separate explicit owner transaction after confirmation.

simulateTax((address,address,address,uin.notice: Simulate the actual prefunded executor, owner and recipient using draft settings. Always reverts, even if accidentally submitted on-chain. No state, approvals or asset transfers can survive this call.

withdrawToken(address,address,uint256).notice: Recovery does not depend on DEX, quotes, metadata, task or expiry. amount=0 reads the entire balance; explicit raw amount does not call balanceOf. Only the owner can choose the recipient. Trigger wallets cannot withdraw.

userdoc.notice: One immutable owner, one prefunded executor. Direct Uniswap/Aerodrome pools.
